title: pr-pane 0.3.1: autoOpen off by default, /prs autoOpen enable|disable
summary: Make the pane opt-in at session start and let people switch auto-open from a command.
description: Jeremy asked (via evolv-marketplace) for autoOpen to default off in 0.3.1, plus /prs autoOpen enable and /prs autoOpen disable.

acceptanceCriteria.text: userConfig.autoOpen defaults to false, and session.start opens the pane only when the option is true
/prs autoOpen enable|disable writes the pr-pane.autoOpen /config row through $.config.set, so the command and /config share one setting that persists across sessions
/prs autoOpen with no argument reports the current setting and says when a policy locks the row; a refused write reports the reason and changes nothing
The three forms are in COMMANDS and the README, and the README Settings table shows the false default
Tests cover the default, explicit on, enable and disable, and a locked row; validate --strict, plugin test and tsc pass

implementationNotes: AC1: tests 'leaves the pane closed at session start by default' and 'autoOpen on opens the pane at session start' pass; plugin.json default is false.

AC2: test '/prs autoOpen writes the /config row and reports it' asserts the key pr-pane.autoOpen and value; Jeremy's live '/prs autoOpen enable' left ~/.claude/settings.json pluginConfigs['pr-pane@inline'].options.autoOpen = true, which a new session reads.
AC3: tests cover the status line and a locked row ('Auto-open is unchanged: ...', 'can't be changed here').
AC4/AC5: README diff in PR #3; 23/23 plugin tests, validate --strict, tsc 0 errors, CI run 39297174694 passed.

AC3 unchecked after release: evolv-marketplace's headless install test (claude -p, v0.3.1) found $.config.set rejecting when the session has no pr-pane.autoOpen row; autoOpen() does not catch it, so enable/disable answer nothing, and the bare form reports 'off' without falling back to options.autoOpen. Interactive enable/disable worked for the inline dev copy only. Fix tracked in PRS-3.

Distribution (checked against GitHub on 2026-10-20): v0.3.1 was never catalogued. evolv-marketplace#22 was closed unmerged after its headless install test found the /prs autoOpen bug (PRS-3), and the catalog went from v0.3.0 to v0.3.2.
finalSummary: Shipped pr-pane 0.3.1 (PR #3, squash 76f77ea, tag v0.3.1, GitHub release). autoOpen now defaults to false. /prs autoOpen [enable|disable] writes the plugin's own /config row through $.config.set, so the command and /config share one setting and there is no precedence rule. Verified by 23/23 tests, validate --strict, tsc, green CI, and Jeremy's live enable/disable/toggle run. The tag went to evolv-marketplace for the catalog bump.
